# Subway Seat for bat

TextMate themes for bat. delta, aichat and anything else built on syntect can use them too.

[bat](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/bat/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.tmTheme`](Subway%20Seat.tmTheme) | `$(bat --config-dir)/themes/Subway Seat.tmTheme` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.tmTheme`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.tmTheme) | `$(bat --config-dir)/themes/Subway Seat Tunnel.tmTheme` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.tmTheme`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.tmTheme) | `$(bat --config-dir)/themes/Subway Seat Enamel.tmTheme` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your shell, after copying the themes to `$(bat --config-dir)/themes`:

```fish
bat cache --build
set -Ux BAT_THEME "Subway Seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your shell, after copying the themes to `$(bat --config-dir)/themes`:

```fish
bat cache --build
set -Ux BAT_THEME "Subway Seat Tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your shell, after copying the themes to `$(bat --config-dir)/themes`:

```fish
bat cache --build
set -Ux BAT_THEME "Subway Seat Enamel"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `$(bat --config-dir)/themes/Subway Seat.tmTheme`.
- Delete `$(bat --config-dir)/themes/Subway Seat Tunnel.tmTheme`.
- Delete `$(bat --config-dir)/themes/Subway Seat Enamel.tmTheme`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
